name: vsp360-mcp
description: Query and manage Hitachi VSP 360 through its REST API.
long_description: Gives Claude access to all 264 operations of the Hitachi VSP 360 1.4 REST API through three discovery tools: find an operation, read its parameters, then call it. The server is read-only by default; operations that change state are refused unless you turn on Allow writes.

tools.name: vsp360_list_operations
tools.description: Search the VSP 360 API operations by keyword or tag.

tools.name: vsp360_describe_operation
tools.description: Show an operation's parameters and request body schema.

url.title: VSP 360 URL
url.description: Base URL of your VSP 360, e.g. https://vsp360.example.com

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of the VSP 360 service account

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the VSP 360 service account

toolsets.title: Direct toolsets
toolsets.description: Optional. Comma-separated API areas (tags) to expose as direct tools, e.g. Device Registry,Platform Alerts

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Allow operations that change state. Leave off for read-only access.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Optional. PEM file of the CA that signed the VSP 360 certificate

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Accept any certificate. For labs with self-signed certificates only.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Where downloaded files are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads/vsp360-mcp

upload_dir.title: Upload folder
upload_dir.description: Optional. The only folder files may be uploaded from. Read-only mode refuses uploads unless this is set.
